whyChoose.heading: The A1 Detailing Difference
whyChoose.subtext: Three reasons Raleigh, Durham & Cary trust us with their vehicles

benefit1.title: Convenience You Can Count On
benefit1.text: We come to your home or workplace and bring everything with us — our own water tanks, generators, and every tool needed. No need to drive anywhere, and no need to provide electricity or water.

benefit2.title: Quality You Can See
benefit2.text: We use only the highest-quality detailing products and professional-grade equipment, applied by trained technicians who handle every vehicle with precision, care, and expertise.

benefit3.title: Trust & Transparency
benefit3.text: Highly rated by our customers for reliability and outstanding results, with clear, upfront pricing and no hidden fees — you know exactly what to expect before booking.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subtext: Simple steps to get your car looking brand new

step1.title: Book Appointment
step1.text: Select your date, time, and preferred service package through our calendar. Choose what works best for you.

step2.title: Confirm Details
step2.text: Provide your vehicle details and service location. We'll confirm all the details to ensure perfect service.

step3.title: We Arrive Ready
step3.text: Our team arrives at your location fully equipped. We bring everything needed—no prep work required from you.

step4.title: Enjoy Results
step4.text: Sit back and relax while we transform your vehicle. When we're done, your car will look absolutely stunning.
